column1: # Guild Operators deployment source manifest, schema 2.
# implementation  source path  installed path  mode  policy  validator
# `common` entries apply to every implementation. The only substitutions are
# {implementation} and {network}. Paths are repository- or target-relative.
# Policies are exact, merge-header, render-cnode, render-dingo,
# cntools-legacy-bundle row stages and publishes the complete immutable legacy
# library bundle named by the strict nested CNTools payload manifest. A
# cntools-generation row names the strict nested CNTools payload manifest and
# its private target root; its individual immutable files are not ordinary
# distribution-plan records. A retire entry has `-` as its source, mode, and
# validator. Unknown columns, policies, substitutions, paths, modes, or
# duplicate installed paths are fatal before target mutation.
# Reader isolation requires the CNTools facade to be the first ordinary
# cnode/Dingo payload activated. The private bundle and generation legs publish
# before this row; the facade then refuses launch while the durable journal is
# present until every remaining ordinary file commits.
